venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU — Faulkner’s 11, White’s nickel
dek: The card says 12. Saturday was 11. White played nickel and sat off. That is why 66–21 still had 75-yard drives the other way.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — 20:11 SEC condensed game sat. Broadcast, not All-22. Charles has not approved publish. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Faulkner wants width: shotgun, three wide, Baugh, one tight end. White wants nickel: two linebackers, extra DB on the slot, stand-up edges. FAU did not beat the front. They beat the cushion.

offense.body:
The depth chart is 12 — Baugh, two tight ends, Singleton and Wilson. Saturday he played 11: one back, one tight end, three wide. Shotgun. Two receivers to each side. Singleton starts. Brown does the damage. Faulkner wanted the field stretched, not two tight ends in a pile.

They huddle. On first down the play clock is in single digits before they snap. The cut skips that. The chart stamps no-huddle. Both lie.

Three answers. That is the offense.

Baugh. Zone one way, bounce when it clogs, power when they smell the end zone. Fourteen for 160. The box says workhorse. The film says first down belongs to him.

Then the quick game. Ball out now. Brown’s 49 is a short catch and a missed tackle. Wilson moves the sticks the same way. Philo is 16-of-21 because the design is rhythm, not hero ball.

Then the shot. Max protect. Abrams, 63, down the sideline. They take the top off after Baugh has already won. They do not live there.

Changeups, so you can see them: nobody in the backfield at the 3, Philo keeps. Brown as a runner. Harpring in the middle. Clark finishes drives.

Condensed tape. Not every snap. This is what kept showing up.
bullets: Card is 12. Saturday is 11 — shotgun, three wide, Baugh, one tight end.
They huddle. First down belongs to Baugh.
Quick game next. Brown’s 49 is YAC, not a bomb.
One deep shot: Abrams 63. They take it. They do not live there.
Empty keep, Brown as a runner, Clark to close.

defense.kicker: Brad White — nickel, sit off, wait
defense.body:
White’s card is a 4-2-5 nickel — two linebackers, extra defensive back on the slot. That is also what he played. Four down. Woods and McCray as the stand-up edges. Graham and Chiles behind them. Kanye Clark on the slot. Built for spread. FAU is spread.

Default rush is four. They wait for the hold. Coleman jumps the late throw. Johnson high-points the duck. That is the reward.

The leak is the cushion. Corners play off. FAU lives on hitch, flat, and out — 34 catches, 5.2 yards a throw. Not bombs. Free access. When the slot is late, Veltkamp gets the easy one. That is 25 first downs and two interceptions in the same night.

The edge has to stay home. Veltkamp’s pylon score is contain lost. The fade to Valsin is Flowers losing the back line. Goal line, they pack it and Ervin still walks in.

Graham (10 tackles) is the linebacker filling the hole. McCloud is the interior. Bett strips it in the fourth.

The front is right for this opponent. The cushion and the edge are how those drives start. Campbell will go hurry-up at the same two spots: the slot and the edge.
bullets: Nickel: two linebackers, extra DB on the slot, stand-up edges.
Rush four. Wait for the hold. Coleman and Johnson take it.
Corners sit off. FAU’s 34 catches are hitch and flat, not explosives.
Contain and the fade are the leaks. Graham fills. Bett finishes.
Campbell attacks the slot and the edge. Same two jobs.

specials.body: Fourth-and-4 from the FAU 35. They leave the offense out there, then Durkin from 53. Clean. 17–0. No punt. Kickoffs are touchbacks.
bullets: Durkin 53 on fourth-and-4. They took the points.

keys: Faulkner’s card is 12. Saturday is 11: shotgun, three wide, Baugh.
Three answers: Baugh, the quick game, one deep shot. They huddle.
White’s nickel sits off and rushes four. FAU dinked the cushion.
The jobs next week: the slot and the edge.
Brown, Wilson, Abrams, Clark, Coleman, Graham. That is the tape.

nextWeek.look: They are the hurry-up team. Florida’s tape is shotgun 11 and nickel. Win the slot. Stay home on the edge.
